definitions.explanation: Prearranged plans or procedures for carrying out something. Implies that steps have been thought out and coordinated in advance.

examples.japanese: {手筈|てはず}を{整|ととの}える。
{手筈|てはず}どおりに{進|すす}める。
イベントの{手筈|てはず}はすべて{整|ととの}っているので{安心|あんしん}してください。
examples.english: All arrangements for the event are in order, so please don't worry.

notes:
{手筈|てはず} refers to prearranged plans or procedures that have been thought out and coordinated in advance. It implies careful, deliberate planning rather than casual preparation.

FORMS:
{手|て} (hand/method) + {筈|はず} (expectation/arrangement).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手筈|てはず}を{整|ととの}える: to make arrangements
- {手筈|てはず}が{整|ととの}う: arrangements are in place
- {手筈|てはず}どおりに: according to plan
- {手筈|てはず}を{決|き}める: to decide on the arrangements

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {準備|じゅんび}: preparations (general, everyday)
- {段取|だんど}り: arrangements, steps (practical scheduling)
- {手配|てはい}: arrangements (often for logistics — booking, dispatching)
- {手筈|てはず}: coordinated plan (more deliberate, formal)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Common in business, organizational, and literary contexts. In casual speech, {準備|じゅんび} or {段取|だんど}り is more natural.
